definitions.candidate_pool: All snapshot nodes, including unusual types; soft priors never filter. R0 is all-type surface-only to isolate the R1 context increment; legacy routed type-prefixed flat remains separately archived.
definitions.cost: Each actually computed query/text-vector dot product costs one; identical stored text vectors are computed once per query view and reused across fields/entities. Offline encoding/index construction excluded and timed.
definitions.grouping: Exact normalized names only, no fuzzy merges. Same resolved target denominator in every stage; report number of underlying nodes covered by top-K groups.
definitions.missing_fields: Contribute zero with fixed weights, without renormalizing available fields; this favors entities with documented context and is a design limitation.
definitions.evidence: Context shared through a presenting article is a separate lower-weight claim_article field; ordinary cited-work provenance is not evidence that every article claim concerns that work.
definitions.resolution: Canonical exact/alias coverage distinct from representable evidence/composites. Composite representability requires all canonical components plus shared article provenance; this is not proof of functional composition.
definitions.metrics: Primary entity recall uses canonical exact/alias targets only. Representable recall separately includes evidence and fully graph-supported composites (all components required). Raw lower bound retains all expected targets. Precision gives one credit per recovered canonical target at fixed K; duplicate mentions cannot add credit. MRR is reciprocal first relevant rank over the exhaustive ranking.
definitions.source: Source hit/recall measures provenance overlap, never semantic entailment. Required sources outside the snapshot remain in resolution coverage and raw lower-bound denominators.
definitions.hierarchy_gate: Implement contextual hierarchy only after the flat original-question checkpoint demonstrates nontrivial recovery; original hierarchy construction remains unchanged.
